text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was so stunned this morning! The whole
dorm
got together to make me a
home-cooked
breakfast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's been hard at work on
the idea
since yesterday. We wanted to
make sure you
really liked it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... I tried making some things too.
Grilled
chicken, soy-milk cake... That
kind of stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's all high-protein food, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's great! You didn't just make me
food, you
made something that's good
for my muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dober, you're awesome. You really get
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're making it into a bigger deal than
it is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But... yeah, you're right. I want to know you as best as I can.
